translation: Twenty-four: The various places were already clear, when suddenly a choking cough arose in the throat; only then did I know that attached in front of the neck there were two more roots with tips pointing outward that were pricking, and I had to rub and draw above the ears to disperse them. The route went from the forehead corners up to the crown, down behind the head, from the jaw more than three inches wide, finishing in two hours. A little more than an inch lower, two more roots came in succession, going straight out above the ears, crossing the crown and descending; I only rubbed the head corners to draw them.
